title: Ep 54 — Barclays goes big on Claude, Sunderland plugs in, and the letter-posting site doing five thousand a month
description: Barclays puts Claude in front of sixteen thousand staff, Google sets hard dates for Gems becoming skills, GitHub Copilot learns to drive desktop apps, and RAW Charging and Believ make fresh national-operator moves into football stadiums and pub chains. Plus a deep dive on Send Letters Online, a Stripe-verified UK hybrid-mail site at over five thousand dollars a month, niched as ClubPost — AI-written sponsor letters that clubs post to raise money.
